name: Galitzenklamm
kurzbeschreibung: The **Galitzenklamm** is a wild, romantic gorge near **Lienz**, featuring well-developed walkways and thundering waterfalls.
beschreibung: Galitzenklamm – The **Galitzenklamm** ranks among the most stunning natural wonders of the **Osttirol** region. This wild, romantic gorge near **Lienz** features well-constructed walkways and roaring waterfalls, surrounded by dramatic rock formations, crystal-clear mountain streams, and fragrant alpine meadows that captivate nature lovers from around the world. A visit in the early morning or at dusk rewards you with especially atmospheric lighting. Located in **Osttirol**, the **Galitzenklamm** is easily accessible from **Leisach**, with the scenic drive itself offering breathtaking views along the way. Families with children will also find plenty to explore and enjoy. The perfect blend of awe-inspiring scenery and warm hospitality makes this a truly unforgettable experience.
